text:
F-3wa4 (Stams, Stiftsarchiv, Frg. 85). Source-assisted reading, 31 October 2026. A research reader reread on the native images, with the Corpus Thomisticum text of the 1882 Leonine edition at hand, passage A (85-2r col. c, 16 lines), passage B (85-1r col. b, lines 4-18) and passage C (85-1v col. c, bottom band, 10 lines). An independent checker read passage D (85-2r col. a, 13 lines) on the image before opening the source, then compared it with the page image of the 1882 Leonine edition, t. I p. 186. All other columns rest on the image-only first reading. Most of canvas 1 is unread under paste residue. Not a verified transcription; accuracy has not been measured.
Conventions: expansions in ( ), lost or supplied text in [ ], (?) doubtful, [hole] physical loss. Boxes are left,top,right,bottom in native pixels on 7360 x 4912 canvases. Columns are lettered a to d from left to right on each face as imaged. Loci are book I, lectio and paragraph of the 1882 Leonine edition / Corpus Thomisticum.
